CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2576 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3. Bus nonce: 71d2e101ef8e59ecfb4f697cd84adb00. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3` or `Fix review: blocked df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 71d2e101ef8e59ecfb4f697cd84adb00`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2576 df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2576-71d2e101`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Carry-routing re-verdict for PR #2576 at head df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3 (unchanged; verify it with git rev-parse of the PR head and stop if it moved). Your earlier verdict at this exact head is the PR comment 6320657454 (gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/comments/6320657454): its verdict stands. The merge train's pre-flight (carry_audit.audit) parks it because some of its notes/observations are read as findings with no `Carry:` marker. Read tools/audit/carry_audit.py (the module docstring at its top gives the exact grammar) and run it against the earlier verdict text to list the unrouted item ids it prints. Then write a new verdict whose first line is exactly the standard `Fix review: merge df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3` line, a short statement that this is a re-issue of comment 6320657454 routing its items (re-check quickly: head unchanged, git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, required check-runs not red; cite fresh evidence in ev/), and one marker per unrouted item id, in the form `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words> (item <id>)` where the observation is deliberately left as is (say why, citing the ruling/section), or `Carry: <GROUP-ID> (item <id>)` only for a group that exists on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster. Do not invent groups. Then run carry_audit on your own verdict text (python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py with the --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster option before the subcommand; read its usage) and require 0 unrouted items before you return it.
